segments.environment: PHYSICAL SPACE: Interior of a Korean barbecue restaurant (東洞). Dark, moody ambient lighting complemented by warm pendant lamps hanging from an exposed ductwork ceiling. Dark flooring and muted grey plaster walls. To the right, a floor-to-ceiling glass window wall looks out onto a sunlit outdoor commercial courtyard with potted green foliage and opposite retail shops. Other patrons sit at dark wooden dining sets in the background. At the head of our table, a male server wearing a dark grey utility short-sleeve shirt, dark bucket hat, black face mask, and black nitrile gloves grills meat on a domed tabletop grill. OBJECTS: A round domed Korean tabletop grill with sizzling pork belly slices and garlic sits on the left, equipped with a curved brushed-metal exhaust hood embossed with '東洞'. Next to XXX on a wooden trivet is a pipinXXX stone pot containing volcano steamed egg (gyeran-jjim) topped with melted cheese, corn, and chopped scallions. Arrayed across the slate-finish table are various side dishes (banchan): a 3-compartment stainless steel condiment tray (gochujang, ssamjang, dry chili seasoning), a paper chopstick wrapper printed with Korean text, a stainless steel water cup, a stainless steel bibimbap/rice bowl, a flat round metal sharing plate, small ceramic bowls holding cabbage kimchi, seasoned perilla leaves, pickled radishes, shredded snacks, and dipping sauces. Beside the window rests a light green thermos jug and a small action camera mounted on a mini desktop tripod pointed at us. In my hands and my companion's hands are two game paddles: XXX red with a white 'X' and XXX green with a white checkmark/arrow icon. SCREEN CONTENT: The mini tripod camera has a small rectangular live preview display showing the tabletop and companion; no readable UI text. No mobile phones or computer monitors are active. TEXT IN THE WORLD: '東洞' stamped on the metal exhaust hood; Korean text '168시간 숙성하여 더욱 깊은 향과 부드러운 고기 맛있다.' on the paper chopstick sleeve; white 'X' on the red paddle. MEDIA BEING PLAYED: None. AMBIENT AUDIO: Sizzling sounds of pork belly on the grill, muffled restaurant conversation, gentle clattering of tableware, and low background dining music.
